# Priyanshu Gupta

> Official personal developer portfolio of Priyanshu Gupta (@priyanshubuild). Learning and building with C++, data structures and algorithms, Linux systems, and modern web applications. Open to internships and collaboration.

The canonical identity is https://priyanshugupta.com/#person. Exact linked accounts distinguish this person from others with the same name. Public, read-only resources; no sign-in or JavaScript is needed to read the text versions. Dynamic GitHub totals must be read with timestamps and error flags.

## Portfolio and project content

- [Portfolio in Markdown](https://priyanshugupta.com/index.md): Identity, learning focus, experience context, section links, exact social/coding profiles and email contact. Human page: https://priyanshugupta.com/
- [Featured projects in Markdown](https://priyanshugupta.com/projects.md): C++ practice, Team BitForge AI Interview Agent, this Next.js portfolio and college storefront practice, including sources and attribution. Human page: https://priyanshugupta.com/projects
- [Complete public guide](https://priyanshugupta.com/llms-full.txt): Self-contained portfolio and project content, activity definitions, freshness, contact behavior and browsing tool reference.

## Structured resources and browsing

- [Public profile JSON](https://priyanshugupta.com/profile.json): Public identity, topics, availability, exact account links, page anchors and resource map.
- [Featured projects JSON](https://priyanshugupta.com/projects.json): Same featured projects as the website, with technologies, repository/demo links and team/coursework attribution.
- [Live GitHub activity JSON](https://priyanshugupta.com/api/github-activity): Personal 365-date calendar and separate all-time public default-branch commit rankings. Check per-source fetchedAt and errors; failed data is not zero. Cache windows: 120 seconds.
- [Browsing task guide](https://priyanshugupta.com/portfolio.skill.md): How to answer common portfolio questions, navigate, interpret activity and use supported read-only tools.
- [Agent resource catalog](https://priyanshugupta.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Discover the public browsing skill.
